crime_highlights: Mr. Jack was encouraged to beat Mr. Thomas and he agreed to do so
Mr. Thomas was taken hard to the ground and likely lost consciousness
Mr. Jack beat and kicked Mr. Thomas who offered no resistance
Mr. Jack was the main player in the death of Mr. Thomas
rationale_highlights: Counsel have submitted, and I accept, that it was those dysfunctions, together with a dysfunctional notion of how to preserve family honour, that contributed to, if it was not the cause of, these young people becoming involved in the events leading to the death of Mr. Thomas

The specific effect on the offender of systemic problems is a factor that may mitigate the severity of a sentence, but the absence of a specific link does not abrogate the need to take into account the fact the offender is aboriginal
note: Court says Gladue link to Jack himself was weak; effect generic.

crime_highlights: Mr. Loring picked up a six-foot long muffler pipe and pounded on the door with it until he broke the door down
Mr. Loring began a search for Trevor Reese
he fired the rifle into the air toward a non-residential hill
The occupants of the Williams house turned out the lights and hid inside while someone called the police
rationale_highlights: the background factors of the appellant were adequately addressed in the sentencing proceedings in the case at bar

given the age of the offender and his lack of adult record, and his aboriginal heritage, I am of the view at the very least it was an error on the part of the sentencing judge to fail to give consideration to the rehabilitative aspect of the sentence imposed
note: Systemic factors thin; mainly community restorative approach and rehabilitation.

crime_highlights: Ms. Jimmie came up behind her and grabbed her purse
when the victim attempted to hit Ms. Jimmie with her cane, both women fell to the ground
The victim suffered minor physical injuries in the attack and continues to suffer from feelings of anxiety and insecurity when she leaves her home
The victim no longer walks in the area where the offence occurred
rationale_highlights: Ms. Jimmie was sent to residential school where she was exposed to an atmosphere of violence
The sentencing judge was clearly alive to the systemic factors that had negatively influenced Ms. Jimmie's formative years and continue to impact her adult life
She identified the mitigating factors as Ms. Jimmie's early guilty plea, her acceptance of responsibility for her actions, her 35 days pre-sentence custody and the factors in Gladue
note: Appeal court summarises trial judge; Gladue factors treated as mitigating.
